summary: We developed a website called Astro Sensor to address the issue of astronauts being exposed to things such as altered gravity and social isolation. More often than not, astronauts fail to recognize these health changes immediately, which can lead to many ailments. Astro Sensor is an accessible and interactive website that is able to receive input and give statistics of their health. Astronauts’ health is important to ensure mission success and advance medical sciences on Earth. Our website aids in tracking health and giving results to astronauts in space. This can help them act on their health issues before it causes a more crucial matter to their wellbeing. Not only is physical health important, but also mental welfare. Missions require intense focus, precision, and rapid problem solving in a pressured environment, and anxiety, depression and cognitive fatigue can impair critical thinking skills. Our website is an attempt to have astronauts input their health data and catch symptoms and prevent further impairment. Astro Sensor can assist astronauts in space for long periods of time by organizing their health data and outputting specific data catered to them.
details: Our project is Astro Sensor, which is an interactive and accessible website designed to improve astronauts’ physical health and mental well-being when located in outer space for an extended period of time. Astronauts can input health information that they take themselves and receive an estimate of their overall health statistics, which can help improve their long term health. Improving the overall health of astronauts, both mental and physical, was a topic that intrigued the whole team. On long-duration spaceflights, astronauts experience an overall clinical incidence rate of 3.40 medical/symptom events per flight year, with 46% of crew members reporting a "notable" adverse event during their mission. We used Github to code the website, and our website has different languages, dyslexia friendly options, accessible designs, settings and the overall interactiveness, making sure that the website is tailored to the user’s experience. Every person is individual and different in their own way, so that was a big factor to consider when creating this. We solved this by making the website able to receive input and cater the results to the consumer. Overall, Astro Sensor is an accessible, user-friendly solution to astronauts' health in general.
